title: A Disk-based Dynamical Constraint on the Mass of the Young Binary DQ Tau
question: What is the dynamical mass of the DQ Tau binary from its circumbinary CO disk, and does it agree with the spectroscopic orbit mass and pre-MS models?

data.sensitivity: continuum 70 uJy/beam; CO and 13CO 8 mJy/beam per 0.1 km/s channel; C18O ~4 mJy/beam per 0.2 km/s channel

what.value: BVRIJ photometry used for the HR-diagram fit

evidence.quote: we explored a two-component fit to the $BVRIJ$ photometry compiled by (cite: rydgren84), (cite: kolotilov89), and (cite: skrutskie06) (cite: andrews13).

what.value: LKM RV differences reconstructed from Table 1 of Mathieu et al. 1997

evidence.quote: We therefore reconstructed the original velocity differences trivially from the primary and secondary “measurements” reported by (cite: mathieu97) in their Table 1.

what.value: Infrared interferometry astrometric constraint used to enforce i > 90 deg

evidence.quote: we employ the astrometric constraint made by (cite: boden09) from infrared interferometry measurements to enforce $i > 90\ensuremath{^\circ}$ in our analysis.

recipe.method: CASA calibration, self-calibration on continuum, time-averaging to 30 s, continuum subtraction, CLEAN imaging with robust 0.5

recipe.goal: Forward-model CO visibilities of Keplerian disk
recipe.method: Parametric disk model, LTE excitation, RADMC-3D ray tracing, Fourier transform to data uv points, chi2 likelihood, 23 contaminated channels excluded
assumptions: Vertically isothermal, radial power-law temperature, hydrostatic equilibrium, Keplerian rotation, LTE

recipe.method: TODCOR two-dimensional cross-correlation with PHOENIX synthetic templates, equal temperatures assumed
key_parameters: Teff ~4000 K, vsini 14 and 11 km/s, solar metallicity, logg 3.5-4.5

recipe.method: Weighted least-squares joint fit of 33 CfA RV pairs and 22 LKM RV differences; uncertainties iteratively adjusted to reduced chi2 near unity
Joint posterior of M and i assuming coplanarity; dynamical distance; mutual inclination
assumptions: Disk and binary planes coplanar for combined mass

recipe.method: Two-component BVRIJ photometric fit with BT-Settl, then masses and ages from pre-MS tracks assuming coevality
key_parameters: logg = 4.0 fixed; RV mass ratio prior 0.93+/-0.05; Teff prior 3900+/-250 K; R_V = 3.1
